package left

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/datatable"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"
)

type User struct{}
type Reply struct{}

var (
	read     http.AccessScopes[User]
	viewer   http.Permission[User]
	editor   http.Permission[User]
	endpoint http.Endpoint[Reply]
	users    http.GuardBinding[User]
	guard    http.Guard[User]
	auth     *http.Authentication
	route    http.Route[Reply]
	handler  = func() {}
)

func open() http.Registration {
	return http.Authenticated(endpoint, users).Handle(handler)
}

func helper(e http.Endpoint[Reply], b http.GuardBinding[User]) http.AuthenticatedEndpoint[Reply, User] {
	return http.Authenticated(e, b)
}

func spread(options ...http.GuardOption[User]) {
	_ = http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, options...)
}

func twice() http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	e = http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Scopes(read))
	e = http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Permissions(viewer))
	return e.Handle(handler)
}

func conditional(strict bool) http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	if strict {
		e = http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Scopes(read))
	}
	return e.Handle(handler)
}

func usedBefore() http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	_ = e.Handle(handler)
	return http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Scopes(read)).Handle(handler)
}

func usedAfter() (http.Registration, http.Registration) {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	return http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Scopes(read)).Handle(handler), e.Handle(handler)
}

func parameter(e http.AuthenticatedEndpoint[Reply, User]) http.Registration {
	return http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Scopes(read)).Handle(handler)
}

func mixed() {
	_ = http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.Scopes(read), http.AnyOf(http.AllOf(http.Permissions(viewer))))
}

func literal() {
	f := func() http.AuthenticatedEndpoint[Reply, User] {
		e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
		return http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.Scopes(read))
	}
	g := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	_ = func() { _ = http.ConfigureAuthenticated(g, http.Scopes(read)) }
	_ = f
}

func tables() {
	_ = datatable.ReadAccess[User]()
}

func mount() {
	var scope http.Scope
	var table datatable.Table
	var config datatable.Config[User]
	_ = datatable.Routes(scope, table, config)
	_ = datatable.Routes(scope, table, config, datatable.ExportAccess(http.Scopes(read)))
}

func guardTaking() {
	_ = http.RequireAuthentication(endpoint, auth, guard, http.Scopes(read))
	_ = http.RequireRouteAuthentication(route, auth, guard, http.Permissions(viewer))
	_ = http.OptionalAuthentication(endpoint, auth, guard)
	_ = http.OptionalRouteAuthentication(route, auth, guard)
	r := http.RequireRouteAuthentication(route, auth, guard)
	_ = http.ConfigureAuthenticatedRoute(r, http.Permissions(editor))
}
